_comment: Parameter schemas for the three custom function tools to create in the Vapi dashboard. Set each tool's server.url to https://<your-domain>/vapi/tools

function.name: check_existing_patient
function.description: Check whether a patient record already exists for a phone number. Call this as soon as the caller gives their phone number. Returns 'FOUND: patient_id=..., first_name=..., last_name=..., date_of_birth=...' or 'NOT_FOUND'.

phone_number.description: The caller's 10-digit US phone number, digits only, e.g. 5125550143

messages.content: Let me check our records for a moment.

function.name: create_patient
function.description: Save a new patient registration. Only call this after reading all collected information back to the caller and hearing an explicit yes. Returns 'SUCCESS: patient_id=...' or 'VALIDATION_ERROR: <field>: <what is wrong>'.

date_of_birth.description: Date of birth as MM/DD/YYYY, e.g. 04/12/1985. Must be in the past.

sex.description: How the caller wants their sex recorded

phone_number.description: 10-digit US phone number, digits only, e.g. 5125550143

email.description: Email address. Omit entirely if the caller declines.

address_line_2.description: Apartment, suite or unit number if any

state.description: Two-letter US state abbreviation, e.g. TX

insurance_provider.description: Insurance company name, if the caller provides one

insurance_member_id.description: Insurance member or policy ID, if provided

preferred_language.description: Preferred spoken language. Defaults to English.

emergency_contact_name.description: Full name of an emergency contact, if provided

emergency_contact_phone.description: 10-digit phone number for the emergency contact, digits only

messages.content: One moment while I save that.

function.name: update_patient
function.description: Update fields on an existing patient record. Use the patient_id returned by check_existing_patient. Send only the fields the caller wants changed. Returns 'SUCCESS', 'NOT_FOUND' or 'VALIDATION_ERROR: ...'.
